title: Intent to Sole Source - MV Davenport Diagnostic & Repair
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS.ENGINEER DIVISION MISSISSIPPI VALLEY.ENDIST ROCK ISLAND.W07V ENDIST ROCK ISLAND
detail_text: Intent to Sole Source. The MV Davenport has experienced poor engine performance from the starboard main engine, affecting the maneuverability of the vessel while conducting fleet operations. After conducting tests and checks through in-house personnel it has been determined that further diagnostics and repairs will be required from a certified CAT service center.
